title: SGD Provably Prioritizes a Shortcut Spurious Feature in the XOR Model
abstract: arXiv:2606.30444v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural networks are known to be susceptible to over-reliance on spurious correlations. However, the precise mechanism by which models exploit shortcut features is not fully understood, and algorithms to mitigate this behavior rely on as yet unjustified assumptions about the learned representations. In this work, we provide the first end-to-end theoretical characterization of spurious feature learning for two-layer ReLU neural networks trained by online minibatch SGD on the logistic loss. We consider data drawn from the high-dimensional Boolean hypercube with a quadratic signal function (namely XOR) and a linear spurious correlation. We show that SGD learns the spurious feature first, and exponentially fast. Moreover, the optimization dynamics couple the spurious and signal features, with a stronger spurious component inhibiting signal feature learning. translated_title: SGD在XOR模型中可证明地优先学习捷径虚假特征
translated_abstract: 众所周知，神经网络容易过度依赖虚假相关性。然而，模型利用捷径特征的精确机制尚未被完全理解，且缓解这种行为的算法依赖于对学习到的表示尚未得到证实的假设。在这项工作中，我们首次对在逻辑损失上通过在线小批量SGD训练的两层ReLU神经网络的虚假特征学习提供了端到端的理论刻画。我们考虑从高维布尔超立方体中抽取的、具有二次信号函数（即XOR）和线性虚假相关性的数据。我们证明SGD会最先学习虚假特征，且学习速度呈指数级快。此外，优化动力学将虚假特征与信号特征耦合在一起，较强的虚假分量会抑制信号特征的学习。我们的分析揭示了学习动力学中精确的相变现象。
tldr: 本研究首次对两层ReLU神经网络中虚假特征学习进行端到端理论分析，证明SGD会以指数级速度优先学习捷径虚假特征，且较强的虚假分量会抑制信号特征的学习。
en_tdlr: This work provides the first end-to-end theoretical characterization showing that SGD provably learns shortcut spurious features exponentially fast, with stronger spurious components inhibiting signal feature learning.
